title: High dev fixture: exhaustive codebase map and snippet economy stress test

status.currentState: The review package demonstrates the complete codebase-review artifact contract: guided UI choices become an agent prompt, the agent emits compact JSON with snippet line ranges, and the CLI renders reusable HTML sections without raw diffs.

status.changeSummary: The output format removes raw diffs in favor of current-state explanations and curated code snippets.

snippets.caption: Extension imports, option types, and wizard state definitions.
Snippet resolution reads local file ranges and records warnings instead of embedding code in JSON.
Codebase template composes status, file map, workflows, data flows, focus, snippets, and validation sections.
CSS is composed from importable style modules without adding a bundler.
Production render entrypoint used by both /pr and /pr-dev.

reviewFocus.question: Are snippets short, relevant, and referenced by line range rather than duplicated into JSON?
Do reusable components explain current code responsibilities and flows clearly without falling back to raw diffs?
Does the artifact include enough surrounding context, workflows, and risks for a human to understand the current system without inspecting raw diffs?

risks.description: Snippet line ranges can drift as files change after JSON generation.
risks.mitigation: Use mustContain anchors for important snippets and surface resolver warnings.

risks.description: If the /pr prompt asks for fields the CLI schema does not accept, the agent will generate invalid JSON and render will fail.
risks.mitigation: Keep guide, example, scaffold, extension prompt, schema, and fixtures aligned.

decisions.decision: Use snippet references instead of inline code.
decisions.rationale: This saves model output tokens and lets the CLI read authoritative code from disk at render time.
The artifact is intended to explain current code structure and workflows, while GitHub remains the source for raw diff review.
alternatives: Keep the legacy renderer as a secondary template
Embed raw diffs in an appendix
